dict.string: OfficeKit reads your selected local calendars to show an animated countdown before meetings. Events stay on this Mac and are never changed or uploaded.
OfficeKit uses optional AirPods head-motion data for calibrated head-angle reminders. Motion is processed locally and is not recorded or uploaded.
OfficeKit uses the microphone for on-device dictation. Audio is processed locally and is not sent to OfficeKit servers.
OfficeKit needs access to your Downloads folder to process files and photos you select.
OfficeKit needs access to your Documents folder to process files and documents you choose.
OfficeKit needs access to your Desktop folder to process files you choose.
OfficeKit needs access to removable volumes to process files you select.
OfficeKit needs access to network volumes to process files you select.
OfficeKit uses screen capture to take screenshots and capture screen audio when requested.
OfficeKit uses system events for desktop shortcuts and system integrations.
